summary: Kerb beside a commercial car park; cars park along it, homes across road.

drivers.seclusion: East side is a commercial car park and retail; nearest dwellings are 20 m or more away, across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Parallel kerb with parked cars in line; the car park entrance sits at about 12-20 m so keep to the first 11 m.
drivers.traffic: Side street close to a main road; moderate traffic, vans in the kerb line are not noticed.
drivers.convention: Cars park nose to tail along both sides in Esri.

flags: Car park entrance apron beyond 12 m
sun_shade: Open; trees on the car park side give some afternoon shade.
cannot_judge: Overnight use of the car park

best_section.where: East kerb of Harrys Road, south of the car park entrance
